name: Document & Report Production
purpose: Turn source material into a finished, checked document or report the user can trust.
summary: Work knowledge for preparing structured documents: gather the source material, follow the structure the user already uses, compute what the document claims, then verify before handing it over.
applicable_context: preparing a report or summary from source data
producing a document for delivery or review
knowledge: locate and read the source material before writing anything
identify the reporting period, audience, and required sections
follow the structure of an existing template when the user has one
derive every number in the document from a source, never from memory
compute aggregates with a checkable method and record the method
keep the document's claims consistent with the underlying data
preserve the user's existing naming and formatting conventions
prerequisites: the source material is available and readable
the destination format or template is known or discoverable
verification_guidance: re-read the finished document and confirm each required section exists
verify totals and key figures against the source data
confirm the saved artifact exists at the intended path
recovery_guidance: if a figure cannot be traced to a source, remove it rather than guess
if the template conflicts with the requested structure, follow the request
re-open the saved file to confirm the write actually landed
